title: Debug Mini Program
summary: At this stage Zepp OS development tools do not support breakpoint debugging code, adding logging is the best debugging tool. This article will cover the following.

approaches.heading: Add logs in the Mini Program

snippets.code:
import { log } from '@zos/utils'

const pageLogger = log.getLogger('page')

pageLogger.log('page created')
pageLogger.error('page error')
